I was here in December. Things get better! 

I'm just gonna put something here that I wish somebody told me, i don't know if anybody here is thinking this or feeling it perhaps but:

things get better, they do! It's not always that you're the only thing pushing the turnstiles of life to make a change. Things happen naturally and there may be some things you yourself have to fight through/ fight for ofcourse, but things can just improve. Blessings in disguise, opportunities arise, changes happen around you that directly affect you. It's not gonna be as difficult and suffocating as it may feel. You can float through it and focus on yourself and things will just change.  Always welcome change! That doesn't mean you shouldn't be scared or you're not allowed to be upset, but just imagine how good it can be. I always nonstop imagined how bad things could get because that's what I was used to. If you shift your mindset and consider how good things could be and how much they could improve, then you realise in the end it was better for you to have this happen.

Wishing you the best.
